content.text:
I'm working through the grid row by row, keeping the 9-part shape intact while erasing cells outside the container and restoring any outline cells that got occluded.

Rows 8 and 11 stay unchanged, row9 col10 flips back to 8, and rows 10-11 remain zeros, so the final grid keeps that 8-shape intact with the 9-line erased except where it restores the boundary.
